name: Kitakami (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kitakami city emblem in green and light blue: a green stylised leaf-like swirl with a light blue stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Kitakami, a city in Iwate Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 11 July 1991.
